_comment: Founder-curated spike priorities for pipeline/scripts/spike-engine.ts — multipliers on the spike queue's ranking only (never any PA Score). Key by arena id or '<arena>/<productId>'. Rationale is the 2026-09 founder ask: deep continuous passes over Stripe's nearest competitors first (payments), then the arenas where Stripe lines compete. Products beat arenas when both match; everything absent defaults to 1.
